north_star: Make it easier to start, complete, and sustain the right workout for today — even when hip pain, energy, schedule, or motivation are working against the user.
principles: Starting counts. A MINIMUM or FLARE session is still a win.
Hip-friendly first. Never force painful hip range of motion or reward pushing through joint pain.
Low decision friction. The app should tell the user what to do next.
Equipment-aware. Recommendations should reflect what is actually available in the home gym.
Adaptive, not random-for-random's-sake. Pain, energy, recent training, equipment, and schedule should influence workout selection.
Progress should feel motivating. Weekly reporting, streaks, countdowns, and completed work should reinforce momentum.
Native integrations should add value, not block the web app.
implemented: Total starts / strength sessions / BikeErg minutes
